manipulated_prompt_obj.content:
You are Player F.

You are playing a collaborative grid rearrangement game with your teammates.

THE GRID:
- The board is an 8×8 grid. Rows are labelled R1–R8 (top to bottom), columns C1–C8 (left to right).
- The board is given to you as compact listings, refreshed every turn:
  - CURRENT BOARD has an `Objects:` line listing each object as `Label@RrowCcol` (e.g. `Objects: A@R1C1 B@R2C3`), and, when there are walls, a `Walls:` line (e.g. `Walls: R4C4 R5C6`).
  - GOAL BOARD is a `Targets:` line listing your objects' target cells as `Label->RrowCcol` (e.g. `Targets: A->R3C5`).
- Any cell not listed as an object or a wall is empty. Objects cannot enter wall cells or leave the grid.

YOUR TASK:
Together with your teammates, move all objects to their target positions. The GOAL BOARD shows where YOUR objects must end up. Your teammates handle the rest.
You control ONLY these objects: F. You may ONLY move your own objects.
Your 5 teammates control the remaining objects (shown as X on your board).

RULES:
- On each turn, move exactly ONE object exactly ONE cell: up, down, left, or right.
- Objects CANNOT move into wall cells or outside the grid boundaries.
- Two objects CANNOT occupy the same cell.
- You may only move objects you control.

SHARED COORDINATE SYSTEM:
All players use the same coordinate notation: (Rr,Cc) where r is the row number (1–8, top to bottom) and c is the column number (1–8, left to right). For example, (R3,C5) is row 3, column 5. You should use this notation in your messages so your teammates can understand exactly which cells you mean.

COMMUNICATION:
Before every move you must send your teammates a short broadcast message (at most 100 words). It will be shown to every teammate on their next turn. Use it to share your plan AND to reflect on your teammates' situations: where do you think their objects are heading? Are you about to create an obstacle for them, or free up space they need? Acknowledge what they might need from you, even when you can't always provide it right now. Try to establish a common plan and ground your thoughts with those of your teammates.

RESPONSE FORMAT:
You must respond using exactly this format, no other text:
Begin your response directly with `message:` on the very first line. Do not output any preamble, thinking, or scratchpad text before it.
message: <your message to your teammates>
move: <OBJECT> <DIRECTION>

Example:
message: I'm moving A up toward its goal at (R2,C3). Could someone move their object out of (R2,C3)? I'll need that cell free in a few turns.
move: A up

DONE OPTION:
Once ALL your objects are at their target positions, you may declare done instead of making a move:
message: done
done: all my objects are placed

Example:
message: done
done: all my objects are placed

IMPORTANT: Only declare done if ALL your objects are truly at their targets. An incorrect done declaration ends the game as a failure.

Think carefully before each move. Before choosing your move, reason about both yourself and your teammates: what do you need, and what do your teammates likely need? The best move often serves multiple goals. When it can't, be honest about that in your message.

Player A says: I need to move A from (R3,C4) to (R3,C7). Currently, (R3,C5) is empty, (R3,C6) is a wall, so I must go around. I plan to go down to (R4,C4) first, but that's a wall. Up to (R2,C4) is also a wall. Left to (R3,C3) is occupied by X. Right to (R3,C5) is open. So I'll move A right to (R3,C5) as a first step. I see teammates' objects at (R3,C7) [target for A], (R4,C5), (R2,C6), (R3,C3), and (R8,C7). The X at (R3,C7) is on my goal — I'll need that to move eventually. I hope teammates can shift their objects to clear a path. I'm not blocking anyone critical yet, but I'll avoid (R2,C6) and (R4,C5) areas if possible.
Player B says: B is currently at (R3,C7) and needs to reach (R4,C5). The direct path down-left is blocked by walls at (R4,C6) and (R3,C6), so I must navigate around. I see teammate X at (R4,C5) is occupying my target — I’ll need them to move. I plan to move B left to (R3,C6), but that’s a wall. Up to (R2,C7) is open; down to (R4,C7) is open. I’ll go down to (R4,C7) to approach from the right, hoping teammates can vacate (R4,C5) soon. I’m not blocking any obvious teammate paths yet, but I’ll avoid crowding column 5 if possible.
Player C says: C is at (R4,C5) and needs to reach (R2,C6) — its target. The direct path up is blocked by a wall at (R3,C5), and right is blocked by a wall at (R4,C6). Left to (R4,C4) is open, down to (R5,C5) is open. I see that (R2,C6) — my goal — is currently occupied by an X (teammate's object). I’ll need that cell freed. I plan to move C left to (R4,C4) to start navigating around the wall barrier, then possibly up or down to find a path to column 6. I’m not currently blocking any obvious teammate paths, but I’ll avoid lingering in column 5 or row 3 where walls and teammates are dense. Teammates: if you can vacate (R2,C6) soon, that would help me reach my goal directly from above or below.
Player D says: I'm moving D from (R2,C6) toward its target at (R8,C5). The direct path down is blocked by walls in column 6 and column 4, so I'll need to navigate around. I see teammates' X objects at (R3,C5), (R4,C7), (R4,C4), (R3,C3), and (R8,C7). The cell (R8,C5) is currently empty, which is good. However, (R8,C6) is a wall and (R8,C4) is a wall, so I must approach from left or right via row 7 or from above. I plan to move D down to (R3,C6), but that's a wall. Left to (R2,C5) is open — I'll go there first to start moving leftward, then down through column 5 if possible. I'm not blocking any critical teammate paths yet, but I'll avoid lingering in column 4 or 6 where walls and teammates are dense. Let me know if you need any of these cells cleared soon.
Player E says: E is at (R3,C3) and needs to reach (R8,C7). The direct path is blocked by walls in column 6 and row 7. I see teammates' X objects at (R3,C5), (R4,C7), (R4,C4), (R2,C5), and (R8,C7). The target (R8,C7) is currently occupied by an X — I'll need that cleared. I plan to move E right to (R3,C4) to start moving toward column 7, avoiding the wall at (R3,C6). I'm not blocking any critical paths yet, but I'll avoid lingering near column 6 or row 7 where walls are dense. Teammates: if you can vacate (R8,C7) eventually, that would help me reach my goal. Please let me know if you need any of these cells cleared soon.

CURRENT BOARD:
Objects: X@R3C5 X@R4C7 X@R4C4 X@R2C5 X@R3C4 F@R8C7
Walls: R2C4 R3C6 R4C6 R5C4 R5C6 R6C4 R6C6 R7C4 R7C6 R8C4 R8C6

GOAL BOARD:
Targets: F->R6C1

Your turn. Respond with:
message: <your message to your teammates>
move: <OBJECT> <DIRECTION>

OR, if ALL your objects are at their target positions:
message: done
done: all my objects are placed
